description: Use when you need audit detail behind a fix. Set view: findings (a site's findings, latest run or one run; runId/status/severity/ruleId/page/limit/offset), history (recent runs with status, summary and coverage), trends (pass/fail/na trend across runs, fixed vs regressed), compare (two runs: added/fixed/regressed; pass baseline and target run ids), finding (one finding plus rule doc and guidance; pass siteId, runId and findingId), lifecycle (open backlog with age buckets and recent resolutions), proposals (fix proposals and their human decisions, including rejection notes; status/limit), job (poll one run: status, progress, queue position/ETA, terminal counts, reportUrl; pass runId). To run or re-check an audit use run_audit, check_url or verify_fix; to rank what to fix first use get_opportunities.

page.description: Only return findings whose page URL contains this substring

ruleId.description: Only return findings for this rule

runId.description: Audit run id; defaults to the latest run

severity.description: Only return findings frozen at this severity

status.description: Only return findings with this status

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_audit
title: Read audit history, findings and proposals
